esp32.detail: 4 pins wired; SDS011 laser PM2.5/PM10 dust sensor needs at least 4.7 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.T → RX2 (the board's RX), R → TX2 (the board's TX). Added the sds011.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the PM2.5 and PM10 set on the sliders: passes

pico.detail: 4 pins wired; SDS011 laser PM2.5/PM10 dust sensor needs at least 4.7 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.T → GP1 (the board's RX), R → GP0 (the board's TX). Added the sds011.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the PM2.5 and PM10 set on the sliders: passes
